name: Panjim (Panaji), Goa — pilot place pack
description: Panjim and the frontage directly touching it on the same bank of the Mandovi (spec section 4). Every layer lists its source, level, grounding and status; placeholder layers are admin-only until replaced. Model parameters live in the science registry, not here.

layers.title: Panjim city footprint (Census 2001 town boundary)
layers.source: DataMeet community maps (CC BY 4.0): Census of India 2001 town boundary of Panaji (CEN_2001 3001000340120000)
layers.note: 2001 boundary; the Corporation of the City of Panaji limits may differ. The Tiswadi taluka footprint (GADM) frames it at state scale.

layers.title: Census 2001 towns of Tiswadi (Panaji, Chimbel, Bambolim, Calapor, Goa Velha)
layers.source: DataMeet community maps (CC BY 4.0): Census of India 2001 town boundaries
layers.note: The SVI census units (packages/core/src/data/svi.json) use these codes.

layers.title: Ward zones (landmark-derived placeholder, 9 zones)
layers.source: Voronoi cells of OpenStreetMap place nodes (Nominatim, 2026-11-04: Patto, Fontainhas, Mala, Altinho, St Inez, Campal, Miramar, Caranzalem, Taleigao, Ribandar, Merces) clipped to the Census 2001 Panaji town boundary; data/places/panjim/tools/ward_zones_from_landmarks.py
layers.replaced_by: CCP ward boundary shapefile (spec section 7, item 5)
layers.note: Not wards: the mockups' landmark zones. Tonca has no OpenStreetMap place node; Ribandar and Merces lie outside the Census 2001 town boundary, so their 'edge' zones are not drawn. The studio never shows these; the admin side does.

layers.title: Landmark positions used for the zones (OpenStreetMap via Nominatim)
layers.source: Nominatim search results, 2026-11-04, bounded to the Panjim window; each hit carries its osm_type/osm_id

layers.title: OpenStreetMap administrative relations in the window (tags only)
layers.source: Overpass API, 2026-10-23 (old repo cache): Goa, North Goa, Tiswadi, Bardez relations

layers.title: Creeks and drains (OpenStreetMap waterways)
layers.source: Overpass API, 2026-10-23 (old repo cache): waterway ways in the window; used by the rain-at-high-tide catchments
layers.replaced_by: CCP / Imagine Panaji drain network and outfall levels

layers.title: DeltaDTM v1.1 Mandovi tile (default terrain)
layers.source: Pronk et al. (2024) DeltaDTM v1.1, 1 arc-second bare-earth coastal DTM (EGM2008), tile supplied by Ferdin (4TU.ResearchData was unreachable); also as terrain/DeltaDTM_Mandovi_EPSG4326.tif; gridded to the CRZ grid in packages/core/src/data/panjimDemGrid.deltadtm.json
layers.note: Pixels above 10 m are outside DeltaDTM's domain and keep GLO-30 (docs/MODEL_AUDIT_LOG_ported.md, DeltaDTM switch).

layers.title: Copernicus GLO-30 (surface model, above 10 m)
layers.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, tile N15 E073, gridded in packages/core/src/data/panjimDemGrid.json

layers.title: CRZ classification grid (CZMP Goa), 55 m cells
layers.source: Goa CZMP (NCSCM, CRZ Notification 2011) raster goa_mandovi_4sec_v3.tif, colour-classified in the old repo (docs/PANAJI_PILOT_DATA_INVENTORY.md); grid in packages/core/src/data/panjimCrzGrid.json; class totals in crz/panjim_crz_classification.csv; preview crz/panjim_crz_classified_map.png
layers.note: The CRZ classification areas are vectorised at run time by the engine's marching squares (packages/core/src/engine/vectorize.ts).

layers.title: CZMP raster (goa_mandovi_4sec_v3.tif, 3.1 m per pixel)
layers.source: Supplied by Ferdin 2026-09-25 (old repo); not committed (size)
layers.note: Kept in the old repo's data/source; decide external object storage before Phase 2 (spec section 5).

layers.title: Khazan polygons (CZMP hatch, vectorised)
layers.source: CZMP khazan hatch, colour-classified and morphologically closed in the old repo, vectorised from the 55 m grid mask (packages/core/tools/khazan_polygons.ts)
layers.replaced_by: manual review against the CZMP sheets; a khazan tenant-association or WRD layer
layers.note: Pre-1991 bunds and sluices are treated as current infrastructure (standing instruction, 2026-09-25).

layers.title: Traced field bunds outside the khazan mask (Patto, Taleigao, St Inez / Merces)
layers.source: Traced in the old repo (Phase 3, A1) from Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016, building footprints and OSM farmland; Ferdin's ground truth that these fields are bunded (23 Oct 2026)
layers.note: Extent reasoned; crest height a registry placeholder (hazards.params.bundCrestM).

layers.title: Sluice-gate candidates and defence notes (CZMP symbology)
layers.source: packages/core/src/data/existingDefenses.json (old repo extraction from the CZMP symbology)
layers.replaced_by: manual digitisation of bund and sluice symbols at full resolution

layers.title: Emergency facilities named in the North Goa DDMP 2022
layers.source: North Goa District Disaster Management Plan 2022 (named in the spec: GPS Karem, GPS Madel, Altinho MPCS); the PDF has not been supplied, so the facilities are listed without positions
layers.replaced_by: the DDMP PDF (spec section 7, item 1) and geocoding against it
layers.note: Nominatim found no OpenStreetMap feature for GPS Karem or GPS Madel on 2026-11-04; nothing was invented.

layers.title: Population: Census 2011 census-unit totals (fallback)
layers.source: Census of India 2011 PCA, census units Panaji, Taleigao, Bambolim, Chimbel, Calapor… in packages/core/src/data/svi.json; GHS-POP 2020 grid rescaled to these totals in panjimPopGrid.json
layers.replaced_by: CCP ward-level population or household survey (spec section 7, item 5)
layers.note: Marked for replacement; growth since 2011 is a registry placeholder.

layers.title: Building footprints and road surface (OSM + Microsoft)
layers.source: OpenStreetMap and Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints, gridded in packages/core/src/data/panjimExposureGrid.json
layers.replaced_by: a survey of building classes and floor levels

layers.title: Policy clause map (instruments × modelled risks)
layers.source: Seeded with the six instruments of spec section 7 and the modelled risks; every cell unassessed until the Policy agent and an expert sign-off (later phase)
layers.replaced_by: clause-level assessments signed off by an expert
layers.note: The studio shows the board with 'awaiting assessment' states; no status is asserted.
